# openwrt_exec (Resource)

Runs a command with `/bin/sh -c` on the router when created (and when `command` or `triggers` change), and optionally another on destroy. Requires an rpcd ACL granting `exec` on `/bin/sh` (see the bootstrap guide).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Shell command to run on create.

### Optional

- `destroy_command` (String) Shell command to run on destroy.
- `environment` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables. Sensitive, so they may carry secrets without showing up in plans.
- `sensitive_output` (Boolean) Do not store stdout/stderr in state (use when the command prints secrets).
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; any change re-runs the command.

### Read-Only

- `exit_code` (Number) Exit code of the create command.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `stderr` (String) Standard error of the create command (null with sensitive_output).
- `stdout` (String) Standard output of the create command (null with sensitive_output).
